disagreements.text: The club championship scoring changed in 2019 from top-6 to top-10. Since then our B team has finished above the A team twice. That's not depth improving, it's the scoring rewarding turnout.
Carbon plates aren't the whole story. My times dropped 2% in the shoes and another 2% the following year in the same pair, when the only thing that changed was going from 35 to 50 miles a week.
